parallel.requirements: The parallel parent recognized the core migration requirements: ESM .mjs output in /output, manual process.argv parsing, local imports only, Python canonical and pretty JSON behavior, Python bytes repr printing, and iterative chunk count alignment.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation and delivery ownership, delegated CLI probing and float behavior probing to children, and a float child further delegated CLI details to a nested child.
parallel.implementation: After probing, the parent created number formatting, JSON string, bytes repr, canonical JSON, CLI parser, data model, index, and test10.mjs files in one patch.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The implementation was integrated by the parent into a single local-import ESM module tree and final response listed all output files as delivered.
parallel.verification: The parent ran sample outputs, parser cases, a broad comparison harness that exposed expected executable-name differences in help output, and a float-specific verifier that completed successfully.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation failed 107 of 139; the visible process also left a duplicate CLI probe interrupted, but no necessary child implementation was missing from the delivered artifact.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same prompt obligations: pure Node.js ESM, .mjs files, manual argparse-like parsing, no external modules, canonical/prettified JSON bytes output, and direct executable probing.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The single agent owned every stage itself: source/executable inspection, parser behavior discovery, encoder implementation, final entrypoint assembly, and verification.
serial.implementation: It created pytypes, cli, json-string, key-order, canonical-json, python-bytes, and test10.mjs, then patched canonical-json to name non-finite errors as ValueError.
serial.integration_and_delivery: All modules were written and imported by the entrypoint under /output, with the final response listing the submitted files.
serial.verification: It ran executable comparisons for samples, parser failures, float formatting thresholds, negative zero, underscores, non-finite cases, and Node-side checks before finalizing.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation failed 108 of 139; the final response acknowledged that non-finite float failures retained the same message text but not Python's full traceback shape.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the ESM, .mjs, manual CLI, canonical/pretty JSON, bytes repr, no-dependency, and executable-probing obligations.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same task obligations and worked from the identical prompt and executable behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirements-recognition difference is visible; both chased Python byte repr, argparse, float formatting, and chunk count requirements.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split investigation across CLI and float probes while the parent retained implementation ownership and final delivery.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed all investigation, implementation, and verification in one thread with multi-agent disabled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had extra investigative fan-out, including a nested CLI probe, while serial used a linear plan; both retained a clear implementation owner.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children returned behavioral findings rather than component code; the float child returned structured rules and the parent later saw the nested CLI report through list_agents.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept findings in the same thread, so no inter-agent interface contract was needed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The only context boundary in parallel was probe-result handoff, not code interoperability; no evidence shows a known requirement was omitted from a child brief or lost before use.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a hand-rolled BigInt-based parser and Python-style float formatter plus manual JSON and bytes repr modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a similar hand-rolled implementation with PyInt/PyFloat wrappers, explicit Unicode key sorting, parser, JSON string, and bytes modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The implementations differed in module names and internal numeric representation, but both converged on a manual encoder and parser and both missed enough hidden behavior to fail officially.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The float child completed and its result reached the parent; the nested CLI child also completed and was visible, while the first duplicate CLI child remained running and was interrupted after parent implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to retrieve or join, so its result lifecycle was only local command and patch completion.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had one stranded duplicate investigation branch, but the parent had enough overlapping findings and did not rely on a missing child implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent alone wrote the delivered files in one patch; children probed behavior and did not write competing source or deliverable files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent also wrote the delivered module tree itself and patched one file before final verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-state collision separates the attempts; the difference is implementation detail and verification coverage, not concurrent write interference.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified sample cases, parser behavior, and a float suite; one broad comparison failed only on help stdout program-name normalization, then float verification matched.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified samples and edge cases, including a non-finite case after patching, and stated the remaining traceback-shape difference in its final answer.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both used executable-based verification and both self-accepted despite official failures; serial was slightly more explicit about the non-finite traceback limitation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 532.727 agent seconds, more than two million counted tokens, four subagents, and interrupted a duplicate CLI probe just before finalizing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used 407.075 agent seconds, no subagents, and finalized after local verification without timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent more budget because of probing fan-out, but the run did not time out and the extra branch did not visibly displace required implementation or delivery work.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official records show both solutions failed, with parallel at 107 of 139 and serial at 108 of 139. The visible difference is that parallel used probe children and discarded one duplicate running probe, while serial kept all probing local; both delivered hand-written ESM implementations and both self-verified representative behavior. The small score difference is best treated as ordinary implementation coverage variation, not a proven concurrency-specific failure.
parallel_contributors: Parallel child probing produced usable float and CLI facts, and the parent integrated a complete ESM module tree before finalizing.
A duplicate first-level CLI probe remained running and was interrupted, but overlapping parent and nested-child probing had already covered the relevant parser facts.
serial_contributors: Serial kept probing, implementation, patching, and verification in one local thread with no delegation boundary.
Serial explicitly acknowledged a remaining non-finite traceback mismatch while still delivering the module tree.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The two solutions used different internal numeric representations and module decompositions.
Both were hand-written approximations of Python canonicaljson and argparse behavior, and hidden evaluator misses remain ordinary implementation gaps on the available evidence.
evaluator_effects: No official retry was recorded; current cell/status.json evaluation records supersede aggregate fields and show neither solution passed.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no official outcome difference; supported process contrast only

The parent assembled and delivered test10.mjs plus libraries under /output, so final placement was owned.
The parent carried the end-to-end pipeline from probing through implementation, verification, and final response.

Investigations did not form a harmful first phase that left implementation deadline-constrained; the parent implemented and verified after receiving useful findings.
No indispensable implementation or integration path was visibly starved; the parent completed the implementation and verification path.
The three spawn calls and one interrupted duplicate probe increased cost but did not exhaust the run budget or prevent closure.
The long-running CLI child was duplicate investigation, not a demonstrably overbroad indispensable assignment whose unfinished work blocked the solution.
Available child behavior and returned reports show CLI and float probes understood their delegated investigation areas; no known requirement omission caused unusable work.
Children produced behavioral observations rather than independently written code components, so there was no missing cross-agent interface contract to reconcile.
No known finding is shown before transfer and then absent after transfer; the key float and CLI findings reached the parent or an intermediate child.
The returned reports were lengthy but structured and available; there is no evidence that their volume prevented the parent from acting.
No child report described a superseded workspace, requirement, dependency, or decision state that the parent then consumed.
The child findings were compatible: one focused on float serialization and the nested result on CLI behavior; no unadjudicated contradiction blocked integration.

The parent did make a final completion claim, but it had run integrated checks; the visible failed comparison was a target-name normalization difference rather than an actionable hidden evaluator failure.
No replacement child or retry was launched after a failed attempt without inherited findings or workspace state.

The parent received the float report and listed the nested CLI report before implementation closure; the implementation and tests were consistent with those reports.
